translations.web: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
translations.bsb: So a second time they called for the man who had been blind and said, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
translations.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
